params.label: Suffix
params.tip: Output suffix → clusters.<suffix> on the track table

params.label: Track populations
params.tip: Track populations to cluster; every selection clustered jointly

params.label: Cluster on
params.tip: Base measures; cell measures are aggregated per track automatically

params.label: Minimum track length
params.tip: Exclude tracks shorter than this many timepoints (cells) before clustering

params.label: Resolution
params.tip: Leiden resolution — higher gives more, smaller clusters

params.label: Calculate UMAP
params.tip: Also compute a UMAP embedding (obsm['X_umap.<suffix>']) for plotting

params.label: Axis
params.tip: Per-feature percentile rescale to [0,1], per-track total normalisation, or none

params.label: Normalise to median
params.tip: Divide each feature by its median before the percentile rescale

params.label: Max fraction (per-track)
params.tip: Exclude features above this fraction of a track's total (0 = off)

params.label: Top percentile
params.tip: Upper percentile mapped to 1.0 in per-feature normalisation

params.label: Bottom percentile
params.tip: Lower percentile mapped to 0.0 in per-feature normalisation

params.label: Log base
params.tip: Base for the log transform (Ln when 0)

params.label: Use PAGA
params.tip: Initialise the UMAP from a PAGA graph (preserves global cluster topology)

params.label: PAGA threshold
params.tip: Edge-weight threshold for the PAGA graph
